correctness.rationale: For all integers m,n>=2 and real beta, the proof constructs the exact arc Grover unitary; applies a dimensionally valid determinant lemma; computes the normalized two-singular-value magnetic bipartite block by a 2x2 Gram determinant; factors the full unitary characteristic polynomial; and derives exact rank, norms, rational-angle minimal periods and density/nullity of the periodic fluxes. At beta=0 and at degeneracy, the polynomial identity and unitarity preserve multiplicities. Three exact matrix characteristic polynomials and 190 other counted symbolic/matrix/period assertions passed. Numerical checks are secondary to a complete algebraic proof.

value.rationale: A small-flux robustness paper motivates determining whether exact periodicity survives arbitrary finite magnetic phases. This theorem gives a full and sharply size-uniform answer: rank exactly eight for every nontrivial one-edge flux regardless of 2mn arc dimension, exact operator-norm four-step return error, and dense but null arithmetic revival phases with exact minimal periods. It covers the natural whole family K_{m,n}, including all imbalances, and distinguishes approximate from exact recurrence. These structural effects are mathematically substantive rather than a narrow recomputation of a table.
